lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I'm sending you coordinates.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Go there.
Tell me what you know.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I'll tell you when you get back.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Also, perhaps all that hero worship in the Ark has made you forget a few things.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I'm your predecessor, and you're in no position to speak to me like that,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: let alone order me around.
I'm not going.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Yes you are.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: That's an order.
You can't give me orders.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I can't believe this.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: These newcomers nowadays have no manners at all!
Tell me what you know.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: What if I don't want to?
I don't have any invested interest in any of this.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I know a lot of people, you little punk. I'll bury you.
I'd like to see you try.
There is no response for a while.
Very well then. Bye.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Three squads were working together for a joint mission,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: searching AREA F-031.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: It's been a long time since all this happened,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: but anyway, my friends and I were assigned together.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: It was a search mission outside the Ark, so everyone was excited.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Back in the day, many search missions were conducted outside the Ark.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Initially, they sent squadrons comprising both humans and Nikkes, but these were soon called off due to the lack of any substantial findings.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: In this instance, we were going to be exploring completely unknown territory, which we figured would be great for our careers.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: For those of us who didn't have any inside connections, it was an invaluable opportunity.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: But during the search,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I got injured and had to return to the Ark.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I ended up being the only one who came back,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: and that's where the story ends.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I don't know what happened to my friends.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I appealed to the government, but never got a response.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: All I knew were their last reported coordinates.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: All these years, I had no idea if they were even alive or dead.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Of course,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I knew their chances of survival would be slim,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: but even if they were dead, I wanted to know how they'd gone, you understand?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: There, are you happy now?
It would have been better if you told me all this from the start.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: You little...

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I was a commander once,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: and I was one long before you put on the uniform.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: And yet, you...

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: ... Never mind. Forget it.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I'm sorry.
Okay, I'll check the coordinates.
There is no response.
I should get moving.
